description: Client-side script for dynamic data table management, including CRUD operations, pagination, sorting, and modal dialogs for a web-based admin panel.

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Resets to first page and fetches data for the specified dataset.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches data from API, updates table and pagination based on sorting state.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Extracts headers from result objects for table display.

methods.name: makeTable
methods.description: Generates HTML table with data, including modals for record details and images, and manages pagination controls.

methods.name: makeModals
methods.description: Creates modals for updating, deleting, and adding records.

methods.name: updateRecord
methods.description: Sends PUT request to update a record.

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: Sends DELETE request to remove a record.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Sends POST request to create a new record.

methods.name: getRowId
methods.description: Retrieves record ID from modal input.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Handles password change via API call.

methods.name: changePageNum
methods.description: Updates current page number based on user navigation.

methods.name: newPageSort
methods.description: Resets to first page and sorts data based on selection.

methods.name: buildLink
methods.description: Builds data fetch link based on sorting options and fetches sorted data.
